# SSH Tunnels

## Access behind NAT
An SSH reverse tunnel forwards a remote port to a local service behind NAT.
Use remote forwarding when an incoming connection cannot reach the private service.
Consulte um túnel reverso para acessar um serviço atrás de NAT.
